newsitem.title: USA: Plasma-Therm chairman to sell shrs.
newsitem.headline: Plasma-Therm chairman to sell shrs.

text.p: Plasma-Therm Inc said Tuesday that its chairman and chief executive Ronald Deferrari intends to sell about 500,000 shares of company stock over the next few years.
Deferrari informed the company that he wants to diversify his holdings as part of his estate planning process, the company said.
The company has 10.59 million shares outstanding.
The company said it is not concerned about the sale because Deferrari's holdings in the company are so substantial.
Plasma-Therm said he owns 2,428,005 shares or 22 percent of the outstanding stock.
